name: smwmusic-pok-mon-nightmare-prophecy-lighthouse
title: Pokémon Nightmare: Prophecy - Lighthouse
description:
A difficult and jarring place. Maybe it is haunted, maybe it is very dangerous; but you have to roam over it nonetheless.

Really good with the haunted feeling, be it in a ghost house or a desolated, abandoned grassland area. The use of colder colours will add to the effect.

And yes it is a remix of Pokemon Gold/Silver/Crystal's lighthouse.
Seems like this game's development was no longer continued by its author. Unfortunately.
